input_fields.name: critical_assertion_failure
input_fields.description: Failure identity, critical status, run identity, and intended output path.

input_fields.name: save_entry
input_fields.description: Pending save gate, output path, and whether a native save has begun.

result_fields.name: save_block_status
result_fields.description: One of blocked, already_saved, not_critical, or needs_manual_review.

result_fields.name: blocked_output_record
result_fields.description: Run/output identity, failure reference, and observation that no success output was written.

procedure: Verify failure identity, criticality, run identity, output path, and pending-save state.
Return one blocked/permit decision to the caller's save gate; do not call a saver or write/delete any artifact.
Record blocked output status and preserve failure evidence; do not manufacture a success artifact.
Return already_saved or needs_manual_review if save was not still pending.
rejection_rules: Reject a non-critical/unassociated failure as a reason to block another run.
Reject a block claim after native writing began.
Do not delete an existing output or retroactively label it failed without ownership evidence.
